Titel: Freelance Cloud Data Platform Lead (Azure, Databricks)
Unternehmen: Marenvik Analytics
Ort: Lissabon (Portugal)
Quelle: LinkedIn
Link: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4131906274/
Abgerufen am: 10.09.2026 09:05

About the job
Marenvik Analytics is a data consultancy with teams in Lisbon, Porto and Copenhagen. For a Scandinavian retail group we are looking for an experienced contractor to lead the build of a new lakehouse platform.

What you will do
Lead a team of six data engineers across two time zones
Design and build a lakehouse on Azure Databricks with Unity Catalog and Delta Live Tables
Migrate the existing on-premises Teradata warehouse, including roughly 1,800 reporting tables
Set up CI/CD with Azure DevOps and infrastructure as code with Terraform
Align with the client's architecture board and product owners on priorities and data contracts

What we are looking for
8+ years in data engineering, at least 3 of them in a lead role
Hands-on experience with Databricks, Spark and dbt
Solid Azure background (Data Factory, ADLS Gen2, networking basics)
Experience with large warehouse migrations
Fluent English; Danish or German is a plus but not required

Contract details
Start: November 2026, 6 months (until end of April 2027), extension likely
Rate: EUR 95 to 115 per hour, excluding VAT, invoiced monthly
Fully remote from anywhere in the EU or EEA, with core overlap 10:00 to 16:00 CET
One onsite kick-off week in Copenhagen, travel costs covered by us
Please note that we cannot engage contractors based outside the EU/EEA because of the client's data residency requirements.

Seniority level
Mid-Senior level
Employment type
Contract
Job function

Industries
